verses.original: וְעַתָּ֥ה שְׁמַ֖ע יַעֲקֹ֣ב עַבְדִּ֑י וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּחַ֥רְתִּי בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh šə·ma‘ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ‘aḇ·dî wə·yiś·rā·’êl bā·ḥar·tî ḇōw
verses.literal: But now listen O Jacob My servant Israel whom I have chosen

verses.original: כֹּה־ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֥ה עֹשֶׂ֛ךָ וְיֹצֶרְךָ֥ מִבֶּ֖טֶן יַעְזְרֶ֑ךָּ אַל־ תִּירָא֙ עַבְדִּ֣י יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וִישֻׁר֖וּן בָּחַ֥רְתִּי בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘ō·śe·ḵā wə·yō·ṣer·ḵā mib·be·ṭen ya‘·zə·re·kā ’al- tî·rā ‘aḇ·dî ya·‘ă·qōḇ wî·šu·rūn bā·ḥar·tî ḇōw
verses.literal: This is the word of the LORD your Maker who formed you from the womb and who will help you Do not be afraid O Jacob My servant Jeshurun whom I have chosen

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶצָּק־ מַ֙יִם֙ עַל־ צָמֵ֔א וְנֹזְלִ֖ים עַל־ יַבָּשָׁ֑ה אֶצֹּ֤ק רוּחִי֙ עַל־ זַרְעֶ֔ךָ וּבִרְכָתִ֖י עַל־ צֶאֱצָאֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’eṣ·ṣāq- ma·yim ‘al- ṣā·mê wə·nō·zə·lîm ‘al- yab·bā·šāh ’eṣ·ṣōq rū·ḥî ‘al- zar·‘e·ḵā ū·ḇir·ḵā·ṯî ‘al- ṣe·’ĕ·ṣā·’e·ḵā
verses.literal: For I will pour water on the thirsty land and currents on the dry ground I will pour out My Spirit on your descendants and My blessing on your offspring

verses.original: וְצָמְח֖וּ בְּבֵ֣ין חָצִ֑יר כַּעֲרָבִ֖ים עַל־ יִבְלֵי־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣā·mə·ḥū bə·ḇên ḥā·ṣîr ka·‘ă·rā·ḇîm ‘al- yiḇ·lê- mā·yim
verses.literal: They will sprout among the grass like willows by flowing streams

verses.original: זֶ֤ה יֹאמַר֙ לַֽיהוָ֣ה אָ֔נִי וְזֶ֖ה יִקְרָ֣א בְשֵֽׁם־ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְזֶ֗ה יִכְתֹּ֤ב יָדוֹ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וּבְשֵׁ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יְכַנֶּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: zeh yō·mar Yah·weh ’ā·nî wə·zeh yiq·rā ḇə·šêm- ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·zeh yiḵ·tōḇ yā·ḏōw Yah·weh ū·ḇə·šêm yiś·rā·’êl yə·ḵan·neh
verses.literal: One will say I belong to the LORD another will call himself by the name of Jacob and still another will write on his hand The LORD’s and will take the name of Israel

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וְגֹאֲל֖וֹ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אֲנִ֤י רִאשׁוֹן֙ וַאֲנִ֣י אַחֲר֔וֹן וּמִבַּלְעָדַ֖י אֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·ḡō·’ă·lōw Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ă·nî ri·šō·wn wa·’ă·nî ’a·ḥă·rō·wn ū·mib·bal·‘ā·ḏay ’ên ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Thus says the LORD the King and Redeemer of Israel the LORD of Hosts I am the first and I am the last and there is no God but Me

verses.original: וּמִֽי־ כָמ֣וֹנִי יִקְרָ֗א וְיַגִּידֶ֤הָ וְיַעְרְכֶ֙הָ֙ לִ֔י מִשּׂוּמִ֖י עַם־ עוֹלָ֑ם וְאֹתִיּ֛וֹת וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּבֹ֖אנָה יַגִּ֥ידוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mî- ḵā·mō·w·nî yiq·rā wə·yag·gî·ḏe·hā wə·ya‘·rə·ḵe·hā lî miś·śū·mî ‘am- ‘ō·w·lām wə·’ō·ṯî·yō·wṯ wa·’ă·šer tā·ḇō·nāh yag·gî·ḏū lā·mōw
verses.literal: Who then is like Me Let him say so Let him declare his case before Me since I established an ancient people Let him foretell the things to come and what is to take place

verses.original: אַֽל־ תִּפְחֲדוּ֙ וְאַל־ תִּרְה֔וּ הֲלֹ֥א מֵאָ֛ז הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֥יךָ וְהִגַּ֖דְתִּי וְאַתֶּ֣ם עֵדָ֑י הֲיֵ֤שׁ אֱל֙וֹהַּ֙ מִבַּלְעָדַ֔י וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר בַּל־ יָדָֽעְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tip̄·ḥă·ḏū wə·’al- tir·hū hă·lō mê·’āz hiš·ma‘·tî·ḵā wə·hig·gaḏ·tî wə·’at·tem ‘ê·ḏāy hă·yêš ’ĕ·lō·w·ah mib·bal·‘ā·ḏay wə·’ên ṣūr bal- yā·ḏā·‘ə·tî
verses.literal: Do not tremble or fear Have I not told you and declared it long ago You are My witnesses Is there any God but Me There is no other Rock I know not one

verses.original: יֹֽצְרֵי־ פֶ֤סֶל כֻּלָּם֙ תֹּ֔הוּ וַחֲמוּדֵיהֶ֖ם בַּל־ יוֹעִ֑ילוּ וְעֵדֵיהֶ֣ם הֵׄ֗מָּׄהׄ בַּל־ יִרְא֛וּ וּבַל־ יֵדְע֖וּ לְמַ֥עַן יֵבֹֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yō·ṣə·rê- p̄e·sel kul·lām tō·hū wa·ḥă·mū·ḏê·hem bal- yō·w·‘î·lū wə·‘ê·ḏê·hem hēm·må̄h bal- yir·’ū ū·ḇal- yê·ḏə·‘ū lə·ma·‘an yê·ḇō·šū
verses.literal: All makers of idols are nothing and the things they treasure are worthless Their witnesses . . . fail to see . . . or comprehend so they are put to shame

verses.original: מִֽי־ יָצַ֥ר אֵ֖ל וּפֶ֣סֶל נָסָ֑ךְ לְבִלְתִּ֖י הוֹעִֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yā·ṣar ’êl ū·p̄e·sel nā·sāḵ lə·ḇil·tî hō·w·‘îl
verses.literal: Who fashions a god or casts an idol which profits him nothing

verses.original: הֵ֤ן כָּל־ חֲבֵרָיו֙ יֵבֹ֔שׁוּ וְחָרָשִׁ֥ים הֵ֖מָּה מֵֽאָדָ֑ם יִֽתְקַבְּצ֤וּ כֻלָּם֙ יַֽעֲמֹ֔דוּ יִפְחֲד֖וּ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ יָֽחַד׃
verses.transliteration: hên kāl- ḥă·ḇê·rāw yê·ḇō·šū wə·ḥā·rā·šîm hêm·māh mê·’ā·ḏām yiṯ·qab·bə·ṣū ḵul·lām ya·‘ă·mō·ḏū yip̄·ḥă·ḏū yê·ḇō·šū yā·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: Behold all his companions will be put to shame for the craftsmen themselves are only human Let them all assemble and take their stand they will all be brought to terror and shame

verses.original: חָרַ֤שׁ בַּרְזֶל֙ מַֽעֲצָ֔ד וּפָעַל֙ בַּפֶּחָ֔ם וּבַמַּקָּב֖וֹת יִצְּרֵ֑הוּ וַיִּפְעָלֵ֙הוּ֙ בִּזְר֣וֹעַ כֹּח֔וֹ גַּם־ רָעֵב֙ וְאֵ֣ין כֹּ֔חַ לֹא־ שָׁ֥תָה מַ֖יִם וַיִּיעָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·raš bar·zel ma·‘ă·ṣāḏ ū·p̄ā·‘al bap·pe·ḥām ū·ḇam·maq·qā·ḇō·wṯ yiṣ·ṣə·rê·hū way·yip̄·‘ā·lê·hū biz·rō·w·a‘ kō·ḥōw gam- rā·‘êḇ wə·’ên kō·aḥ lō- šā·ṯāh ma·yim way·yî·‘āp̄
verses.literal: The blacksmith . . . takes a tool and labors over the coals he fashions an idol with hammers and forges it with his strong arms Yet he grows hungry and loses his strength . . . he fails to drink water and grows faint

verses.original: חָרַ֣שׁ עֵצִים֮ נָ֣טָה קָו֒ יְתָאֲרֵ֣הוּ בַשֶּׂ֔רֶד יַעֲשֵׂ֙הוּ֙ בַּמַּקְצֻע֔וֹת וּבַמְּחוּגָ֖ה יְתָאֳרֵ֑הוּ וַֽיַּעֲשֵׂ֙הוּ֙ כְּתַבְנִ֣ית אִ֔ישׁ כְּתִפְאֶ֥רֶת אָדָ֖ם לָשֶׁ֥בֶת בָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·raš ‘ê·ṣîm nā·ṭāh qāw yə·ṯā·’ă·rê·hū ḇaś·śe·reḏ ya·‘ă·śê·hū bam·maq·ṣu·‘ō·wṯ ū·ḇam·mə·ḥū·ḡāh yə·ṯā·’o·rê·hū way·ya·‘ă·śê·hū kə·ṯaḇ·nîṯ ’îš kə·ṯip̄·’e·reṯ ’ā·ḏām lā·še·ḇeṯ bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: The woodworker . . . extends a measuring line he marks it out with a stylus he shapes it with chisels and outlines it with a compass He fashions it in the likeness of man like man in all his glory that it may dwell in a shrine

verses.original: לִכְרָת־ ל֣וֹ אֲרָזִ֔ים וַיִּקַּ֤ח תִּרְזָה֙ וְאַלּ֔וֹן וַיְאַמֶּץ־ ל֖וֹ בַּעֲצֵי־ יָ֑עַר נָטַ֥ע אֹ֖רֶן וְגֶ֥שֶׁם יְגַדֵּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: liḵ·rāṯ- lōw ’ă·rā·zîm way·yiq·qaḥ tir·zāh wə·’al·lō·wn way·’am·meṣ- lōw ba·‘ă·ṣê- yā·‘ar nā·ṭa‘ ʾō·rɛn wə·ḡe·šem yə·ḡad·dêl
verses.literal: He cuts down cedars or retrieves a cypress or oak He lets it grow strong among the trees of the forest He plants a laurel and the rain makes it grow

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה לְאָדָם֙ לְבָעֵ֔ר וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֵהֶם֙ וַיָּ֔חָם אַף־ יַשִּׂ֖יק וְאָ֣פָה לָ֑חֶם אַף־ יִפְעַל־ אֵל֙ וַיִּשְׁתָּ֔חוּ עָשָׂ֥הוּ פֶ֖סֶל וַיִּסְגָּד־ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lə·’ā·ḏām lə·ḇā·‘êr way·yiq·qaḥ mê·hem way·yā·ḥām ’ap̄- yaś·śîq wə·’ā·p̄āh lā·ḥem ’ap̄- yip̄·‘al- ’êl way·yiš·tā·ḥū ‘ā·śā·hū p̄e·sel way·yis·gāḏ- lā·mōw
verses.literal: It serves as fuel for man He takes some of it to warm himself and he kindles a fire and bakes his bread He also fashions it into a god and worships it he makes an idol and bows down to it

verses.original: חֶצְיוֹ֙ שָׂרַ֣ף בְּמוֹ־ אֵ֔שׁ עַל־ חֶצְיוֹ֙ בָּשָׂ֣ר יֹאכֵ֔ל יִצְלֶ֥ה צָלִ֖י וְיִשְׂבָּ֑ע אַף־ יָחֹם֙ וְיֹאמַ֣ר הֶאָ֔ח חַמּוֹתִ֖י רָאִ֥יתִי אֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: ḥeṣ·yōw śā·rap̄ bə·mōw- ’êš ‘al- ḥeṣ·yōw bā·śār yō·ḵêl yiṣ·leh ṣā·lî wə·yiś·bā‘ ’ap̄- yā·ḥōm wə·yō·mar he·’āḥ ḥam·mō·w·ṯî rā·’î·ṯî ’ūr
verses.literal: He burns half of it in the fire and he roasts meat on that half He eats the roast and is satisfied Indeed he warms himself and says Ah I am warm I see the fire

verses.original: וּשְׁאֵ֣רִית֔וֹ לְאֵ֥ל עָשָׂ֖ה לְפִסְל֑וֹ יִסְגּוֹד ל֤וֹ וְיִשְׁתַּ֙חוּ֙ וְיִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֵלָ֔יו וְיֹאמַר֙ הַצִּילֵ֔נִי כִּ֥י אֵלִ֖י אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·’ê·rî·ṯōw lə·’êl ‘ā·śāh lə·p̄is·lōw yis·gōḏ lōw wə·yiš·ta·ḥū wə·yiṯ·pal·lêl ’ê·lāw wə·yō·mar haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî kî ’ê·lî ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: From the rest he makes a god his graven image He bows down to it . . . and worships he prays to it and says Save me for you are my god

verses.original: לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ וְלֹ֣א יָבִ֑ינוּ כִּ֣י טַ֤ח מֵֽרְאוֹת֙ עֵֽינֵיהֶ֔ם מֵהַשְׂכִּ֖יל לִבֹּתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō yā·ḏə·‘ū wə·lō yā·ḇî·nū kî ṭaḥ mê·rə·’ō·wṯ ‘ê·nê·hem mê·haś·kîl lib·bō·ṯām
verses.literal: They do not comprehend or discern for He has shut their eyes so they cannot see and closed their minds so they cannot understand

verses.original: וְלֹא־ יָשִׁ֣יב אֶל־ לִבּ֗וֹ וְלֹ֨א דַ֥עַת וְלֹֽא־ תְבוּנָה֮ לֵאמֹר֒ חֶצְי֞וֹ שָׂרַ֣פְתִּי בְמוֹ־ אֵ֗שׁ וְ֠אַף אָפִ֤יתִי עַל־ גֶּחָלָיו֙ לֶ֔חֶם אֶצְלֶ֥ה בָשָׂ֖ר וְאֹכֵ֑ל וְיִתְרוֹ֙ לְתוֹעֵבָ֣ה אֶעֱשֶׂ֔ה לְב֥וּל עֵ֖ץ אֶסְגּֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yā·šîḇ ’el- lib·bōw wə·lō ḏa·‘aṯ wə·lō- ṯə·ḇū·nāh lê·mōr ḥeṣ·yōw śā·rap̄·tî ḇə·mōw- ’êš wə·’ap̄ ’ā·p̄î·ṯî ‘al- ge·ḥā·lāw le·ḥem ’eṣ·leh ḇā·śār wə·’ō·ḵêl wə·yiṯ·rōw lə·ṯō·w·‘ê·ḇāh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh lə·ḇūl ‘êṣ ’es·gō·wḏ
verses.literal: And no one considers in his heart no one has the knowledge . . . or insight to say I burned half of it in the fire and I baked bread on its coals I roasted meat and I ate Shall I make something detestable with the rest of it Shall I bow down to a block of wood

verses.original: רֹעֶ֣ה אֵ֔פֶר לֵ֥ב הוּתַ֖ל הִטָּ֑הוּ וְלֹֽא־ יַצִּ֤יל אֶת־ נַפְשׁוֹ֙ וְלֹ֣א יֹאמַ֔ר הֲל֥וֹא שֶׁ֖קֶר בִּימִינִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: rō·‘eh ’ê·p̄er lêḇ hū·ṯal hiṭ·ṭā·hū wə·lō- yaṣ·ṣîl ’eṯ- nap̄·šōw wə·lō yō·mar hă·lō·w še·qer bî·mî·nî
verses.literal: He feeds on ashes His deluded heart has led him astray and he cannot deliver himself or say Is not this thing in my right hand a lie

verses.original: זְכָר־ אֵ֣לֶּה יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כִּ֣י עַבְדִּי־ אָ֑תָּה יְצַרְתִּ֤יךָ עֶֽבֶד־ לִי֙ אַ֔תָּה יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֥א תִנָּשֵֽׁנִי׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵār- ’êl·leh ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·yiś·rā·’êl kî ‘aḇ·dî- ’āt·tāh yə·ṣar·tî·ḵā ‘e·ḇeḏ- lî ’at·tāh yiś·rā·’êl lō ṯin·nā·šê·nî
verses.literal: Remember these things O Jacob for you are My servant O Israel I have made you and you are My servant O Israel I will never forget you

verses.original: מָחִ֤יתִי כָעָב֙ פְּשָׁעֶ֔יךָ וְכֶעָנָ֖ן חַטֹּאותֶ֑יךָ שׁוּבָ֥ה אֵלַ֖י כִּ֥י גְאַלְתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mā·ḥî·ṯî ḵā·‘āḇ pə·šā·‘e·ḵā wə·ḵe·‘ā·nān ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯe·ḵā šū·ḇāh ’ê·lay kî ḡə·’al·tî·ḵā
verses.literal: I have blotted out your transgressions like a cloud and your sins like a mist Return to Me for I have redeemed you

verses.original: רָנּ֨וּ שָׁמַ֜יִם כִּֽי־ עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה הָרִ֙יעוּ֙ תַּחְתִּיּ֣וֹת אָ֔רֶץ פִּצְח֤וּ הָרִים֙ רִנָּ֔ה יַ֖עַר וְכָל־ עֵ֣ץ בּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ גָאַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִתְפָּאָֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: rān·nū šā·ma·yim kî- ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh hā·rî·‘ū taḥ·tî·yō·wṯ ’ā·reṣ piṣ·ḥū hā·rîm rin·nāh ya·‘ar wə·ḵāl ‘êṣ bōw kî- ḡā·’al Yah·weh ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·ḇə·yiś·rā·’êl yiṯ·pā·’ār
verses.literal: Sing for joy O heavens for the LORD has done this shout aloud O depths of the earth Break forth in song O mountains you forests and all your trees For the LORD has redeemed Jacob and revealed His glory in Israel

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ גֹּאֲלֶ֔ךָ וְיֹצֶרְךָ֖ מִבָּ֑טֶן אָנֹכִ֤י יְהוָה֙ עֹ֣שֶׂה כֹּ֔ל נֹטֶ֤ה שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ לְבַדִּ֔י רֹקַ֥ע הָאָ֖רֶץ מִי אִתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh gō·’ă·le·ḵā wə·yō·ṣer·ḵā mib·bā·ṭen ’ā·nō·ḵî Yah·weh ‘ō·śeh kōl nō·ṭeh šā·ma·yim lə·ḇad·dî rō·qa‘ hā·’ā·reṣ mī ʾit·tī
verses.literal: Thus says the LORD your Redeemer who formed you from the womb I am the LORD who has made all things who alone stretched out . . . the heavens who by Myself spread out the earth

verses.original: מֵפֵר֙ אֹת֣וֹת בַּדִּ֔ים וְקֹסְמִ֖ים יְהוֹלֵ֑ל מֵשִׁ֧יב חֲכָמִ֛ים אָח֖וֹר וְדַעְתָּ֥ם יְשַׂכֵּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mê·p̄êr ’ō·ṯō·wṯ bad·dîm wə·qō·sə·mîm yə·hō·w·lêl mê·šîḇ ḥă·ḵā·mîm ’ā·ḥō·wr wə·ḏa‘·tām yə·śak·kêl
verses.literal: who foils the signs of false prophets and makes fools of diviners who confounds . . . the wise and turns their knowledge into nonsense

verses.original: מֵקִים֙ דְּבַ֣ר עַבְדּ֔וֹ וַעֲצַ֥ת מַלְאָכָ֖יו יַשְׁלִ֑ים הָאֹמֵ֨ר לִירוּשָׁלִַ֜ם תּוּשָׁ֗ב וּלְעָרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ תִּבָּנֶ֔ינָה וְחָרְבוֹתֶ֖יהָ אֲקוֹמֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mê·qîm də·ḇar ‘aḇ·dōw wa·‘ă·ṣaṯ mal·’ā·ḵāw yaš·lîm hā·’ō·mêr lî·rū·šā·lim tū·šāḇ ū·lə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh tib·bā·ne·nāh wə·ḥā·rə·ḇō·w·ṯe·hā ’ă·qō·w·mêm
verses.literal: who confirms the message of His servant and fulfills the counsel of His messengers who says of Jerusalem She will be inhabited and of the cities of Judah They will be rebuilt and I will restore their ruins

verses.original: הָאֹמֵ֥ר לַצּוּלָ֖ה חֳרָ֑בִי וְנַהֲרֹתַ֖יִךְ אוֹבִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·mêr laṣ·ṣū·lāh ḥo·rā·ḇî wə·na·hă·rō·ṯa·yiḵ ’ō·w·ḇîš
verses.literal: who says to the depths of the sea Be dry and I will dry up your currents

verses.original: הָאֹמֵ֤ר לְכ֙וֹרֶשׁ֙ רֹעִ֔י וְכָל־ חֶפְצִ֖י יַשְׁלִ֑ם וְלֵאמֹ֤ר לִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ תִּבָּנֶ֔ה וְהֵיכָ֖ל תִּוָּסֵֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·mêr lə·ḵō·w·reš rō·‘î wə·ḵāl ḥep̄·ṣî yaš·lim wə·lê·mōr lî·rū·šā·lim tib·bā·neh wə·hê·ḵāl tiw·wā·sêḏ
verses.literal: who says of Cyrus My shepherd will fulfill all that I desire who says of Jerusalem She will be rebuilt and of the temple Let its foundation be laid
